text:
michelle_prod: Quick update: weve launched a small H200 Dedicated pool in ap-south-1 (Mumbai) and added additional H100 capacity to ca-central-1 (zones a/b). This is targeted at customers migrating latency-sensitive workloads in APAC and Canada.

devin_infra: Rollout details: ap-south-1 initially 10 H200 GPUs total (soft cap 4/account). ca-central-1 added +8 H100 GPUs spread across a/b (soft cap unchanged). To request higher quotas, use the Dedicated GPU quota form and select the GPU family. Typical review 48-72h.

archi_eng: Note on compatibility: H200 images require driver v1.9+ and our runtime v2.4.0. We pushed a compatibility shim for K/V caching differences; please test model families with the staging pool before migration.

infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot: ap-south-1 p95 token-latency 70ms, p99 110ms, avg gpu util 39%. ca-central-1 p95 48ms, p99 80ms, avg util 68%. No node failures reported.

sam_support: Support process: customers requesting urgent capacity should open a ticket and include expected tokens/sec and preferred zones. Tag tickets with "dedicated-mumbai" or "dedicated-canada" for faster routing.

nora_partner: Heads up partners: we have 3 pilot slots available in Mumbai for validated partners. If you're onboarding partners, DM me with partner name and target date.

michelle_prod: Action items: (1) eng-infra to add an alert for region imbalance (pager if spare GPUs <15% per-region) @devin_infra, (2) archi to post compatibility notes and a quickstart checklist in internal docs @archi_eng, (3) support to publish KB and escalation flow @sam_support.

devin_infra: Will add alert and a new reservation flag region_preference: "prefer"|"strict". Also creating a one-off migration slot pool for critical enterprise migrations.

michelle_prod: We'll hold external customer comms until 24-48h of stable telemetry. Posting internal docs: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/dedicated/h200-ap-south1-ca-central1-topup. Ping here for any issues. :rocket:
